root_cause: Tenant AI and data-residency configuration changes were written to the immutable cross-domain impact ledger and displayed in the customer portal, but did not create a durable Brain obligation for follow-up review.
prevention: One immutable tenant impact event opens exactly one idempotent canonical Brain obligation, not an isolated task scheduler.
Reject mismatched tenant, change, missing impact dimensions or unauthorized runtime approval claims.
Preserve applicability and emissions as UNDETERMINED; no automatic regulatory conclusion or runtime activation.
Backfill existing ledger rows idempotently without modifying fulfilled work or forcing an unsupported executor.

evidence.outcome: New and historical tenant impact events now generate canonical OPEN Brain follow-up obligations; live policy change and authorized review closure still require independent production evidence.
